title: Today's cost attributes distilled usage to its sprint and session through the work sidecars
goal: usage_today reads the committed work sidecars' per-item usage and maps each item to its sprint, so on a day of sprint work most dollars are not under session distilled and sprint none

run:
import json,subprocess as s,sys
d=json.loads(s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--json','--panel','querylog'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180).stdout)['panels']['querylog']['data']['usage_today']
print(d['usd'],d['by_sprint'])
sys.exit(0 if d['usd']>0 and d['by_sprint'].get('none',0)<d['usd']/2 else 1)
